slides.title: Project Summary
slides.subtitle: Internal tooling — no model training involved this week

bullets.text: Goal & Motivation (2 mins)
Weekly reports are re-typed into the template by hand
Objective: one command from outline to conformant deck
Current Architecture Recap (3 mins)
Role map: every template slide addressed by role
Builder: clone role slide, replace text, validate, QA
Current Status & Results (3 mins)
22/22 roles mapped; both packages build and validate
Discussion Items (2 mins)
Should outline.json be lab-wide, or stay personal?
Keeping the package in sync when the template is revised
Conclusion & Todolist

slides.notes: 先說清楚這週是工具不是研究，免得老師以為我在做模型。整個報告大概三分鐘帶過，重點放在最後的討論題。如果老師問為什麼值得做，第三頁有量化的時間成本。

slides.title: Format compliance should not cost thinking time

bullets.text: Every member re-applies the template by hand, every week
Hand-copying drifts: wrong breadcrumb, placeholder text left in
The handbook rules are prose nobody re-reads before a meeting
Target: prep time goes to the argument, not the layout

slides.notes: 這頁的論點是成本不大但每週都在付。我自己量過，套版加檢查大概二十分鐘，一學期就是七八個小時。更麻煩的是手工複製會漂移，麵包屑跑到錯的段落、範本的佔位字留在投影片上，這些在會議上很難看。所以目標不是省時間，是把格式變成自動的。

slides.title: Outline in, template-conformant deck out
slides.subtitle: Four stages, each with one thing it guarantees

rows: layout and breadcrumb inherited, not rebuilt
fonts, tiers and table styling survive

slides.notes: 四個階段分開的原因是每一段只保證一件事，出錯時很容易定位。第二階段是關鍵：投影片是從範本複製出來的，不是重畫的，所以麵包屑和色條一定對。如果被問為什麼不用 pptxgenjs，答案就是從零生成做不出實驗室這個版型。

slides.title: This deck is the tool's own output
slides.subtitle: Built from a 7-entry outline in one command, nothing hand-edited

bullets.text: 22/22 roles mapped and cloned cleanly
Schema validation passes against the template baseline
No placeholder text survived the QA gate

video.caption: Demo  outline.json to a validated deck, 3s

slides.notes: 這頁的質性結果就是投影片本身，所以我直接放了一段錄影。影片是 outline.json 跑到驗證通過的完整過程，三秒，會自動播放並循環。如果老師想看細節，我可以停下來一步一步講。量化的部分只有三行，因為真正的證據是這份檔案。

slides.title: Open: portability, and template drift

bullets.text: AnythingLLM has no sandbox — the plain skill emits only the outline
Fix: make outline.json the contract, so any executor can finish
A revised template silently stales the role map — version it?

callout.label: To discuss
callout.text: Is this worth sharing with the lab, or does per-person tooling cost more maintenance than it saves?

slides.notes: 這頁我想留在螢幕上討論。可攜性的問題是結構性的：沒有沙箱的環境只能產出 outline，檔案要在別的地方組出來。範本漂移比較好解，加一個版本欄位讓它壞得大聲一點就行。最後那個紅框是真的想聽老師的意見。

slides.title: Conclusion
slides.subtitle: Next week: version the template, then test the portable path
table: Add a template version field so a revision fails loudly, not silently
Test the plain skill inside AnythingLLM and confirm the outline round-trips
Extend the role map to the paper-study track for the next reading session

slides.notes: 待辦留在畫面上讓老師補。前兩項是這週就會做完的，第三項要等下次讀論文才有真的測試資料。第四項是決策，不是工作項目，所以我把它放在最後。
